q: A company needs to unify customer profiles coming from several systems. Which Data 360 feature should a consultant use?
e: Identity Resolution aplica match e reconciliation rules para unificar perfis de origem em um Unified Individual.

q: Which two objects can be used in identity resolution match rules? Choose 2 answers
e: Match rules usam atributos do Individual, contact points (ex.: Contact Point Email) e Party Identification.

q: A record must be visible to a user who is neither the owner nor above the owner in the role hierarchy. OWD is Private. What is the most scalable declarative option?
o: Change OWD to Public Read Only
e: Sharing rules abrem acesso de forma declarativa e escalável quando há um critério; manual sharing não escala e Apex managed sharing é para lógica que regras não cobrem.
